title: Appraisal Order Size Surcharge Schedule
content:
Two property-size surcharges are set for every Appraisal Order report type: the gross-living-area surcharge (also called the complexity surcharge) and the acreage surcharge. Each has a threshold and an amount.

| Report type | Gross-living-area threshold (square feet) | Gross-living-area surcharge (USD) | Acreage threshold (acres) | Acreage surcharge (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop) | 4000 | 100.00 | 5.00 | 75.00 |
| Larkspur Exterior-Only Appraisal (Form 2055) | 4000 | 100.00 | 5.00 | 75.00 |
| Larkspur Condominium Appraisal (Form 1073) | 4000 | 150.00 | 5.00 | 125.00 |
| Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004) | 4000 | 150.00 | 5.00 | 125.00 |
| Larkspur FHA Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004 FHA) | 4000 | 150.00 | 5.00 | 125.00 |
| Larkspur Small Residential Income Appraisal (Form 1025) | 4000 | 200.00 | 5.00 | 150.00 |
| Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo) | 4000 | 250.00 | 5.00 | 200.00 |

**Thresholds.** The gross-living-area threshold is a whole number of square feet and is 4000 square feet for every report type; the gross-living-area surcharge relates to a gross living area **above** that threshold. The acreage threshold is stated in acres to two decimals and is 5.00 acres for every report type; the acreage surcharge relates to a site **above** that threshold.

**Amounts.** The surcharge amounts differ by report type and are stated in US dollars as shown in the table.

### Points of reading

- *Is a property at exactly the threshold above it?* No. A gross living area of exactly 4000 square feet, or a site of exactly 5.00 acres, is at the threshold, not above it; 4001 square feet or 5.01 acres is above it.
- *Does the threshold change with the report type?* No. Both thresholds are the same for all seven report types; only the amounts differ.
- *Hypothetical reading:* for an order of the Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004), the gross-living-area surcharge figure is 150.00 dollars and the acreage surcharge figure is 125.00 dollars.
